name: Ivory
description: Ivory is a website template for dental clinics, with a smile map that shows prices per area, tabbed price lists, a before and after slider and a team of dentists. Cobalt and sand, the Red Hat Display typeface and a bento layout give the website a calm, modern character. Replace the copy, photos, clinic details, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Smile map for choosing an area and seeing its services with prices
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Opening hours and children's duty section
